units.source_text: 十八日之后的进山伐木仪式，二十三日的后祭宵山、屏风庙会，二十四日的花车游行，

en.t: After the mountain-entry logging ceremony on the eighteenth, there are the Yoiyama and folding-screen festival of the later festival on the twenty-third, and the float procession on the twenty-fourth,

units.source_text: 此后还有慰神演出狂言，二十八日“洗轿”，

en.t: followed by kyogen performances offered to comfort the gods, and the washing of the portable shrine on the twenty-eighth,

units.source_text: 然后回到八坂神社，二十九日举行奉神祭，至此结束整个神事。

en.t: then the procession returns to Yasaka Shrine, and on the twenty-ninth the dedication festival is held, bringing the entire sacred observance to an end.
